page_topic_one_liner: Character chat platforms — persona cards, roleplay threads, and UGC character libraries
differentiator_vs_generic: Anime/game character persona card feeding multi-turn RP chat bubbles, NOT customer support widget or talking avatar video.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Mobile chat UI with large character portrait avatar, persona trait chips blurred, and alternating user/character speech bubbles with typing indicator dots
Horizontal scroll of three mini character persona cards (fantasy warrior, anime companion, game NPC) — avatar art only, no names
2x2 grid of chat mood vignettes (casual RP, adventure scene, emotional support, group chat) — bubble fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on persona memory/traits chip row above chat input
anti_patterns: Generic LLM dark sidebar without character portrait
